'''Lilit Arranda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Lilit Arranda was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her husband, she enlisted in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. She underwent training as a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] and was eventually assigned to serve aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Arranda was part of a group of ''Executor'' crewmembers who were tasked with solving the murder of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanith Sorn]].
